findings.title: Recomputed proposal is displayed as the user's saved quantity
findings.cause: isSaved only checks existence of saved.byTemplate[ws], while quantity.planned comes from freshly computed view.taskPlans and never reads the saved target task/quantity/stage. composeV4 replays durable transfer policy only; normal saved per-task allocation is applied by existing applySaved in PlanSection, not in taskPlans.
findings.expected: The top summary must agree with the existing PLAN editor for a matching saved task/stage: saved2 is2, not recomputed6 labeled saved. A newly calculated stage/quantity must be labeled a proposal; absent/mismatched target task or historical stage must not inherit saved labeling merely from Workspace existence. If both saved and proposed amounts are displayed, distinguish both explicitly.
findings.minimum_fix: Reuse the existing applySaved/planDrift/PlanSection source semantics in next-action; use real SavedWorkspace/latest.plan task data, preserving existing transfer-policy replay rules. Keep current rank/diagnosis, delivery, G2 and history unchanged. Replace empty-object saved fixtures with real saved payloads. No SQL, new table or broad learning-engine refactor.
findings.recheck: Normal unsaved and matching-saved controls; edited saved allocation2 versus calculated6; old stage versus current stage; actual top/PLAN agreement. Add focused unit/interaction coverage and reuse unchanged official19-browser paths. Only rerun final-head browser scope affected by this correction; do not rerun unchanged whole product locally.
